userImpact: Runtime images use a patched query-string serialization dependency.

instructions: Upgrade to the qualified release images. Standalone consumers must refresh their own qs dependency resolution to 6.16.1 or later in the supported 6.x line.

notes: The frozen bootstrap retains its existing predecessor code, migration inventory and schema-plan identity while refreshing its production dependency store.

security: The workspace qs minimum is 6.16.1. Existing all-severity scanner gates and ignore policy remain unchanged.
knownLimitations: Exact-image security, supported database adapters and real-engine browser qualification remain required before publication.
